title: [Feature request] add predefined profiles modifications
body:
I do profiles modifications several times a day, especially before lunch I increase the percentage for 30 or 60min.

As I do it really often with always the same parameters, I thought we could add predefined profiles modifications like we did it for the temporary target, we could add 2 or 3 default profiles modifications into the profile UI.

The default values can be set using configuration menu and are stored permanently.

We could maybe set custom icons but this would optional.
